title: Which Egg Hides the Dragon?
youtube_description:
Can you guess which egg is hiding the dragon? Pick your door — then watch the reveal! 🐉🔥 Come back tomorrow for Level 2!

#Shorts #KidsVideo #GuessingGame #DragonEgg #Kidify #FunForKids #PuzzleForKids

scenes.narration: One of these eggs is hiding a DRAGON. Can you guess which one?
You've got three choices — the red egg, the blue egg, or the golden egg!
scenes.visual_prompt: red blue gold Easter eggs row

scenes.narration: Think fast! Pick your egg before the countdown hits zero!
The red egg cracks open and… it's a rubber duck! Quack quack!
The blue egg cracks open and… it's a tiny little snail! So slow!
The GOLDEN egg cracks open and… a baby dragon pops out! ROAR!
Did you get it right? Come back tomorrow for Level 2 — it's even trickier!
